resources.string: Blocks the apps and websites you chose until your focus lock ends, and keeps FocusLock\'s own settings closed during a lock. FocusLock reads only which app is open, browser address bars and the text of Settings screens. Nothing leaves your phone.
Blocks apps and websites during a lock
Stops FocusLock from being uninstalled while a lock is running. FocusLock asks for no other device admin powers.
FocusLock can\'t be removed during a lock. Outside a lock, use FocusLock → Settings → Allow uninstall.
